svg.aria-label: In Claude Code, /themis:themis audit is typed; each rule of CLAUDE.md gets a verdict: cut, cut, rewrite, move, keep; a card asks to apply the changes, the cursor clicks Yes, the cut and moved rules are struck through, NEVER skip the tests becomes Don't skip the tests, and the card says 4 changes applied.
svg.text: Checked against the repo, applied only after you say yes.
